root_cause: The integration helper conflated integrity with whole-session host performance within 15 seconds. The runtime correctly preserved the overrun as failed; unprofiled time outside worker calls is not attributed to a specific host operation.
summary: Initial focused run: 85 pass, one failure. Both synthetic workers succeeded in about 0.219 seconds, but total session took 16.6927 seconds and correctly failed its 15-second cap. After test-only correction, all 86 focused tests passed.
